card.name: Emergency kit supply list items
card.fires_on: Dashes and words inside a bulleted emergency-preparedness supply list (water, food, radio, flashlights, blankets). It also fires weakly on a few words in survival-style text.

modes.label: List dashes
modes.description: The dash that starts each new bullet in a disaster-kit supply list.
modes.example: - Water (1 gallon per person per day for 3 days) <<->> Food that does not need electricity for storage

modes.label: Words inside kit items
modes.description: Linking or modifying words within a kit item, such as 'and', 'or' or 'emergency'.
modes.example: - First aid kit and<< emergency>> medical reference manual - Prescription medications and
